name: Full Stop
tagline: Ink, paper and one dot that takes the colour of whatever just happened.
summary: A New Wave page in the Weingart and Greiman line: stretched-wide type, stepped lines, the grid drawn on the paper, every scale labelled. The page has no colour of its own. Colour arrives only when a product does something, so the live feed is drawn as a piano roll, and the logo, a single dot, always shows the hue of the latest event. Retired work stays on the timeline beside the live products, because a record with 7 retired entries and 2 live ones is more convincing than any adjective.
voice: Numbers first, adjectives never; every claim is a count, a year or a unit. "Shipping software since 2016: 11 products, 2 live, 1 building, 1 paused, 7 retired."
motion: Teletype: text arrives one character at a time behind a cursor in the live colour, and notes drift left at the speed of the wall clock.
sound: Off until asked; then each typed character is a 28 ms band-passed noise click synthesized in Web Audio, with a lower thud for spaces.
mark: A single full stop, a filled circle whose colour is the hue of the most recent event (the favicon follows it too).
